content.comment_body: Good morning, can anyone provide guidance on how to change the VPN IP address? Additionally, is it possible to have two VPNs connected at the same time? Has anyone prepared a Pre-Shared Key setup document?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for instructions on changing a VPN IP address, options for connecting to multiple VPNs simultaneously, and available documentation about Pre-Shared Key configuration. This suggests a need for more comprehensive configuration guidance, improved feature discoverability, and better documentation support for VPN features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward directions on modifying a VPN IP, clarity about multi-VPN connectivity, and easy access to documentation for setting up Pre-Shared Keys.
